fact: Amnons Business Report says MTN South Sudan's Starlink partnership launched in September 2024 following approval from the National Communications Authority.
MTN South Sudan announced nationwide sale of Starlink kits and subscriptions through its customer service and Connect Stores.
Le Monde reports Starlink has been officially accessible in South Sudan since 22 August 2024, authorised by the authorities, with 1,300 terminals in use and four resellers approved by the NCA.
South Sudan's NCA says it granted Starlink a provisional licence and approved four tariff plans, with service preparing to launch.
South Sudan's National Communication Authority said a Satellite Landing Rights License and a Provisional Service License for Starlink were signed on 26 June 2024.
